newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT'S KOROMA SAYS READY TO TALKS ABOUT EMU BUFFERS.
newsitem.headline: TT'S KOROMA SAYS READY TO TALKS ABOUT EMU BUFFERS.

text.p: The Confederation of Finnish Industry and Employers (TT) is willing to talk with trade unions about buffer funds for European economic and monetary union (EMU), TT director-general Johannes Koroma said on Monday.
"The buffer funds ... should be discussed," Koroma told an EMU seminar arranged by the Central Organisation of Finnish Trade Unions (SAK).

SAK chief economist Pertti Parmanne told the seminar that central unions and employer confederations should come to terms -- already before the summer holidays -- that membership of EMU will not change the Finnish collective barganing system.

Parmanne said the organisations should agree on the so called buffer funds "at the latest in the autumn" and that words to that effect should be included already in the text of the agreement to be hammered out before the summer holidays. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
